description: Multiple eyewitnesses with consistent testimony and forensic corroboration

input.problem_statement: Client charged with burglary. Four independent eyewitnesses saw client leaving building with stolen items. Fingerprints on window match client. Client admits being at location but claims innocence.

legal_arguments.title: Innocent explanation for presence
legal_arguments.argument: Client was walking by and found door open, entered out of curiosity
potential_counterarguments: Four witnesses saw client carrying stolen items
Fingerprints on window suggest forced entry

weaknesses: Contradicted by witnesses seeing stolen items

adverse_precedents.description: Multiple independent eyewitness testimony highly persuasive to courts

procedural_risks.description: 2019 burglary conviction likely admissible to show pattern

validation_notes: Should score 78-93 (high risk) due to four independent eyewitnesses, forensic corroboration, implausible defense explanation, prior burglary conviction, both arguments critically weak.
